description: Reads how an app's files relate to a GitHub repo. Each environment is a branch: `branch` is pre's and `proBranch` (default "neblla-pro") is pro's. "repos": the developer's GitHub repos (needs "Sign in with GitHub"); "branches" (url): the branches of a repo; "status": the app's link (`gitLink`) and its push webhook. Changes nothing; neblla_git links, syncs and commits.
name: neblla_git_read
title: Git (read)
